<a id="vic_init_table"></a>
### [`vic_init_table`](../../../../src/data/vic_init_table.asm#L6) `$4310-$433E`

*data*

Start values of the VIC-II registers $d000-$d02e. $5030 copies them, and skips each byte $ff. Sprites off, $d018 = $1c, colours of border, background and sprites.

- **Read by:** [`vic_set_registers`](../init/vic_setup.md#vic_set_registers) [`$5032`](../../../../src/init/vic_setup.asm#L14)
